mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku (product_id, sku_name, spec_values, price, market_price, cost_price, stock, image, sku_code, weight, status) VALUES (#{productId}, #{skuName}, #{specValues}, #{price}, #{marketPrice}, #{costPrice}, #{stock}, #{image}, #{skuCode}, #{weight}, COALESCE(#{status}, 1))
mapper.update:
UPDATE sku
sku_name = #{skuName}, spec_values = #{specValues}, price = #{price}, market_price = #{marketPrice}, cost_price = #{costPrice}, stock = #{stock}, image = #{image}, sku_code = #{skuCode}, weight = #{weight}, status = #{status},
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sku SET stock = stock + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sku SET locked_stock = locked_stock + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock - locked_stock >= #{quantity}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sku WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY price ASC
